title: Track C — 2-WL Matched-Workload Comparison Protocol
purpose: Compare computational work/timing on a matched frozen workload using a fresh 2-WL implementation and the current optimized engine-related computation, without claiming task or expressive equivalence that has not been proved.

measurement.warmup: one untimed warm-up per method per family

track_c_2wl.requirement: Use an explicitly preserved executable 2-WL implementation; define its input representation, initialization, refinement-to-stability rule, output statistic, and timing boundary before measurement.
track_c_2wl.optimization: Implementation may be optimized before measurement, but must be frozen before any comparative timing is observed.

comparison_firewall: 2-WL is not automatically the same computational task as full G-to-poset reconstruction.
Historical collision experiments do not establish general expressive equivalence between 2-WL and the reconstruction engine.
Do not report a winner/speedup as if methods solve the same task unless a separate equivalence result supports that interpretation.
Allowed comparison: matched-instance computational timing/work for explicitly defined outputs, with task-boundary caveat.
Do not alter v74 Track A or v75 Track B.
next: Audit and freeze the exact 2-WL implementation and timing boundary before executing Track C.
